parsed.why: No trans-specific offence or visitor-facing restriction; courts protect expression and hate speech is punishable. But documented police failure to protect assembly, workplace discrimination and large anti-LGBT mobilisation show hostile social climate with only partial recourse.

Fresh penal code criminalises same-sex conduct and undefined 'promotion', fixed by birth sex; gender-nonconforming presentation alone now draws documented arbitrary arrests and abuse. Junta threat-framing, no complaint mechanism, no recognition.

Life imprisonment for same-sex acts, separate subnational statute, documented witch hunts, forced anal exams, custody torture and 2024 mutilation of a trans activist; no recognition or recourse, website blocking. State-tolerated targeting with impunity.

Decriminalised since 2016, no documented trans-specific violence, hostility or state threat-framing; detention rules bar gender-identity discrimination. Negatives are resident-facing gaps (no recognition/protection) plus unanswered prison-placement question.

Morality offences (five years) applied to gender nonconformity and transition itself; religious rulings bar care; no protections, no registrable organisations. Militia killings of effeminate men dated but state protection absent in armed-group areas.
